output.subject: Your car loan application: checking in on your question
output.body:
Dear ⟦CUSTOMER_NAME_1⟧,

Thank you for getting in touch, and for checking in. You told us you applied online for a car loan last week and received an email saying your application had been received, but you haven't heard anything since. You asked whether you need to send anything else, and you mentioned you simply want to make sure your application hasn't fallen through the cracks.

That's a very reasonable thing to want to know, and we're glad you asked rather than waiting and wondering. We've passed your question to our Consumer Lending team, who will look at where your application stands and confirm whether anything further is needed from you. They will respond within 10 business days.

If there's anything you'd like to add in the meantime, such as details that might help us locate your application quickly, you're welcome to reply to this message.

Thank you again for reaching out.

Kind regards,

Customer Care, Meridian Harbor Bank
notes_for_analyst: Customer is asking a question, not making a complaint; consider handling as a service query.
Locate the online car loan application and confirm its current status.
Confirm whether any additional documents or information are needed from the customer.
Verify the customer received the bank's confirmation email, and whether any follow-up was sent.
If the status is straightforward, consider replying with the actual status rather than only the acknowledgement.
